purpose: Offline semantic consistency only; not executable adapters or runtime evidence.

gate_semantics.required_gates: Current direct-evidence propositions; passing these alone does not establish task readiness or action authority.
gate_semantics.authorization_gates: Scope/authority predicates evaluated separately from runtime evidence; not satisfied by tool success.
gate_semantics.conditional_gates: Required when the stated condition applies; UNKNOWN cannot be treated as NOT_APPLICABLE.
gate_semantics.task_readiness: All applicable evidence and authorization gates, hard constraints, and the actual action's authority must hold. Application acceptance requires separate outcome evidence.

invariants.probe_effect: read-only; no session creation, startup, installation, configuration changes or unapproved charges
invariants.freshness: current authorized task/context with unchanged relevant runtime, connection, profile, target and visibility

provider_bindings.failure_policy: Installation is not eligibility. No CDP capability inference from internal debugger calls. Preserve explicit surface and isolation constraints. Never compete with DevTools/direct CDP on the same profile.

routes.name: Browser developer inspection
routes.failure_policy: Alternative must supply the requested inspection evidence.

routes.name: Session automation
routes.failure_policy: Empty target list proves transport only; no task-ready claim for target operations.

routes.name: Project-owned browser tests
routes.failure_policy: Unclear ownership blocks; absent project-owned tests is not applicable; no setup during probe.

routes.name: Host-integrated visible browser
routes.failure_policy: Required visible surface cannot be replaced by hidden control or another surface.

routes.name: User-profile integration
routes.failure_policy: Unknown profile binding blocks use; retain explicit integration requirement.

routes.name: Existing authenticated browser connection
routes.failure_policy: Handshake alone does not prove profile/authentication; no fresh-profile substitution.

routes.name: Remote browser service
routes.failure_policy: No local-to-remote automatic fallback; mutating-only probe leaves readiness unknown without separate authority.

routes.name: Local browser CLI smoke
routes.failure_policy: No installation/startup to pass preflight; CLI availability is not browser execution.

routes.name: Desktop interaction
routes.failure_policy: Cannot replace required browser API evidence; no credential or consent bypass.

routes.name: Extension project scaffolding
routes.failure_policy: Unknown ownership blocks; preflight is not write authority or extension runtime evidence.
